text: # Sample Email: Response to Billing Dispute **Document ID:** EML_001 **Category:** C04 — Billing & Invoices **Department:** Billing **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-15 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Email --- **Subject:** Update on Your Billing Dispute — Ref CMP-2026-77120 **From:** NovaTel Billing Support <support@novatel.example> **To:** Customer <registered-email-on-file> ## Context This correspondence follows an earlier customer contact (call or app request) regarding the matter below, and reflects the outcome of the internal review. ## Previous Actions - Customer request logged and assigned a reference number. - Case reviewed by the relevant internal team against the applicable policy/SOP. ## Email Body **Subject: Update on Your Billing Dispute — Ref CMP-2026-77120** Dear Customer, Thank you for reaching out regarding the disputed charge of ₹149 on your July bill. On review, this charge relates to a Value Added Service (Caller Tune Pack) activated via SMS on 12 July 2026. As we could not verify explicit consent for this activation, we have processed a full refund of ₹149 to your account balance, effective today. We have also deactivated the service to prevent recurrence. Warm regards, NovaTel Billing Support ## Resolution / Recommendation The outcome above reflects the applicable policy and is considered final unless the customer provides new information within the stated window. ## Follow-up Requirements The customer is invited to reply to this email or contact care with the reference number if further clarification is needed. ## References No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the
